violations.description: General employee practices. — --Food employee observed drinking/using open beverage container outside of designated area. -Observed uncovered drinking cup in food prep area.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Observed dried food in microwave.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. -Observed item in hand sink upon arrival.
Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. -Observed handle of ice scoop in ice.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. -Observed items in refrigerator that were not date marked.
